risks.evidence: NASA Ames 2026: folding/deploying from the aeroshell is the biggest challenge (above-cloud aircraft); only 2-4 fold aircraft demonstrated [D-ag]; pre-spun release loses 26 m vs 559 m unspun [K]
risks.mitigation: spin up while hanging on a bridle (Dragonfly practice), spring hinges with latches, balloon-drop tests on Earth at 1-2 km (ρ match 54-55 km, Izraelevitz 2025)

risks.risk: Energy: night falls before mission goals are met
risks.evidence: loiter 1.62 kW vs 1.11 kWh battery; solar sustains loiter only for cos z > 0.68 → ~44 h per air-mass day [K]
risks.mitigation: release at the morning hour angle where the array first covers loiter; science prioritised early; sunset dive as planned end; hybrid He cell as mentor-approved alternative

risks.evidence: 75-98 wt% H2SO4 [D-ag]; FEP 0 % weight gain at 120 °C [D-ag]; CFRP in conc. acid: no data [A]
risks.mitigation: FEP/PFA on every wetted surface, Parylene on cells (−5 % power), sealed motor cans; acid-chamber qualification of wrapped CFRP

risks.risk: Battery overheats in dives / cannot charge
risks.evidence: interior > 60 °C for any dive to 48 km; 52 km dives peak ~57.5 °C [K]
risks.mitigation: variable-conductance heat pipe (diode), dive abort at 50 °C, PCM heat sink option

risks.evidence: VEGA-2 downdraft -2..-3.3 m/s over ~2 h pushed the balloon ~2.9 km down [D-ag]; holding costs W·w/η ≈ 1.4 kW at 3 m/s [K]
risks.mitigation: ride it (altitude band 51-58 km), climb back after (~0.37 kWh)

risks.risk: Large slow rotors: poor control bandwidth, flap dynamics
risks.evidence: rpm-control response ~0.3-1 s for +20 % thrust: fine for slow vertical gusts, too slow for attitude [K]; MSH found a large coaxial hard to control [D-ag]
risks.mitigation: per-rotor collective actuators (fast thrust), stiff blades, control-law tests in simulator

risks.evidence: 1000 km relay orbit: 13 min passes, ~330 Mbit/pass [K]; above 53 km path absorption ~0 [D-ag]
risks.mitigation: onboard storage and autonomy; 2 relay passes per orbit geometry; direct-to-Earth beacon

risks.risk: Navigation drift (no GNSS, no magnetic field)
risks.evidence: baro altitude ±0.2 km from probe spread [K]; ground position error grows ~5 m/s × t [K]
risks.mitigation: navigate in the air-mass frame; orbiter Doppler/range fixes each pass

risks.evidence: β 25 kg/m² aeroshell at −9.5°: 56 g peak [K] (PV large probe 280 g [D-ag]); shallow-entry peak g is model-sensitive: our 29 g vs 48 g published for a rigid β 208 case at −8.5° (Venkatapathy 2016 via agent), not explained by the upper atmosphere (Venus-GRAM profile: < 3 % change) → factor ~1.7 [K]
risks.mitigation: shallow entry corridor −8…−11°, folded arms locked against body, qualification to 100 g; obtain the published case's interface altitude / lift assumptions

risks.evidence: probe spread ±2 % ρ at 55 km, VIRA at dense edge; wind 50-90 m/s band [K/D-ag]
risks.mitigation: size on 'thin' case; air-mass-frame operations make wind speed irrelevant to survival
